rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub BARs() if (HasError == false) Then If pv_MAG.Value == 0 Then dist_mag_height1 = 240 dist_mag_color1 = "white" dist_mag_height2 = 0 dist_mag_color2 = "none" title2 = "Недостоверное" Else If pv_MAG.Value == 1 or pv_MAG.Value == 11 Then dist_mag_height1 = 60 dist_mag_color1 = "Col_Green" title2 = "Нормальное" if pv_MAG.Value == 11 then dist_mag_height2 = 240 dist_mag_color2 = "white" title2 = "Нормальное + Недостоверное" else dist_mag_height2 = 0 dist_mag_color2 = "none" end if Else If pv_MAG.Value == 2 or pv_MAG.Value == 12 Then dist_mag_height1 = 120 dist_mag_color1 = "Col_Yellow" title2 = "Неудовлетворительное" if pv_MAG.Value == 12 then dist_mag_height2 = 240 dist_mag_color2 = "white" title2 = "Неудовлетворительное + Недостоверное" else dist_mag_height2 = 0 dist_mag_color2 = "none" end if Else If pv_MAG.Value == 3 or pv_MAG.Value == 13 Then dist_mag_height1 = 180 dist_mag_color1 = "Col_Orange" title2 = "Тяжелое" if pv_MAG.Value == 13 then dist_mag_height2 = 240 dist_mag_color2 = "white" title2 = "Тяжелое + Недостоверное" else dist_mag_height2 = 0 dist_mag_color2 = "none" end if Else If pv_MAG.Value == 4 or pv_MAG.Value == 14 Then dist_mag_height1 = 240 dist_mag_color1 = "Col_Red" title2 = "Экстремальное" if pv_MAG.Value == 14 then dist_mag_height2 = 240 dist_mag_color2 = "white" title2 = "Экстремальное + Недостоверное" else dist_mag_height2 = 0 dist_mag_color2 = "none" end if Else dist_mag_height1 = 0 dist_mag_color1 = "none" dist_mag_height2 = 0 dist_mag_color2 = "none" title2 = "Не активен" End if End if End If End If End If End If
if (pv_RMAG.Value == True) Then title1 = "Есть недостоверность лог. блоков" else title1 = "" End If
End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: Set pv_MAG = BIN(dist_mag) Set pv_RMAG = BIN(dist_mag_vis_ram) If (pv_MAG == Nothing || pv_RMAG == Nothing) Then HasError = true Rectangle.fill="black" body1.fill="black" Exit Sub End If
